row.evidence: Small Improvements' SSO guide says 'The SAML integration is only for Single-Sign-On, so no users get automatically populated into Small Improvements'; users come from manual entry, CSV import, Google Workspace or HRIS sync.
row.notes: New row. No SCIM endpoint is documented anywhere; Okta, OneLogin and Entra apps are SAML SSO only (Okta OIN ticks SAML and SWA, Microsoft says provisioning is a manual task). User lifecycle comes from a vendor-run Google Workspace import (suspension in Google deactivates the user), HRIS integrations (BambooHR, Personio, Namely, Rippling, Workday, Workable, Kallidus, SFTP), scheduled CSV import from a remote server, or manual CSV. Plans: Launch $3, Grow $6, Elevate $9 per user/month billed annually; minimum 20 users on Launch and Grow and 30 on Elevate. Which plan includes SAML SSO is not stated publicly (the full feature list is behind an email form); SAML also needs a subdomain set up by support. The REST API is provided as-is and must be requested via a project form.

plans.name: Launch
plans.notes: Card lists Google Sign-in and HRIS integrations.

scim.notes: No SCIM endpoint documented; vendor's SSO guides state the IdP integrations are SSO only and do not sync user accounts.

user_api.notes: The app's own internal REST API, exposed as-is: customers must submit an implementation spec form and wait 7-10 business days for activation; no setup support, and endpoints can change without notice. EU tenants use eu.small-improvements.com. No plan restriction is stated.

auth.notes: Personal Access Token created under Profile > Manage > API Access Tokens, sent as Authorization: Bearer.

capabilities.notes: Swagger lists lockUsers/unlockUsers under /v2/users/roles but does not describe them; whether they deactivate users is not documented. CSV user import is also exposed.

audit_log_api.notes: audit-record-resource in the Swagger reference; plan availability not stated.

limitations.text: API is provided as-is, can change without notice, and must be activated by request.

okta.notes: OIN page marks only SAML and SWA as checked (read from page markup); no SCIM or provisioning.

google.notes: Small Improvements' own Google Workspace Marketplace app imports users on a schedule and marks Google-suspended users Deactivated; Google deletions are not propagated.

onelogin.notes: From Small Improvements' own OneLogin guide (OneLogin catalogue not loaded).

fallbacks.other_sync: Google Workspace user import, HRIS integrations (BambooHR, Personio, Namely, Rippling, Workday, Workable, Kallidus, SFTP), scheduled CSV import from a remote server
fallbacks.notes: A user must exist in Small Improvements before SSO login works (no JIT). Manual deactivation frees the licence; deletion erases all history.
